test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Appal
solution: The correct answer is '**Assure**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Appal**' is '**Assure**'. • **Appal**: to make someone have strong feelings of shock or of disapproval. (किसी को सदमा या अस्वीकृति की तीव्र भावनाएँ देना) • *Example: The thought of war **appalls** me.* • **Assure**: to say something that removes doubt or worry. (कुछ ऐसा कहना जिससे संदेह या चिंता दूर हो) • *Example: *He assured us that everything would turn out all right. **Correct Answer:__** *Assure.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Alarm**: a sudden feeling of fear or worry. (एकाएक उत्‍पन्‍न डर या चिंता; घबराहट) • **Amaze**: to surprise somebody very much; to be difficult for somebody to believe. (अत्‍यधिक चकित कर देना; किसी बात का अविश्‍वसनीय हो जाना) • **Astound**: to surprise somebody very much. (भौंचक्‍का या आश्‍चर्यचकित कर देना) 17c:T5b3, The correct answer is** 'To be similar in appearance'.**
